presets.label: Slow Reveal
presets.description: The panel opens at a calm, unhurried pace with no item highlighted, letting the menu settle in gently.

presets.label: Snappy Open
presets.description: A quick, crisp pop-open that lands with the first item already highlighted.

presets.label: Deep Hover
presets.description: The menu opens at a measured pace with the highlight resting on the last item, as if the cursor has travelled down the list.

presets.label: Collapsed Trigger
presets.description: Only the trigger button is shown, with the panel closing smoothly away for a minimal resting state.

presets.label: Quick Dismiss
presets.description: The panel snaps shut fast, like a menu dismissed by a decisive click elsewhere.

presets.label: Mid Focus
presets.description: A relaxed open with the highlight sitting on a middle item, suggesting a deliberate choice mid-list.
